units.title: Hypercalcemia thresholds and the three cause groups
units.guide: >10.5 mg/dl starts evaluation (adjusted 8.6–10.3; 0.25 mmol = 0.5 meq/l = 1 mg/dl). Parathyroid dependent 80%: primary HPT (m/c overall, F>M, 6th decade; adenoma 85% inferior gland; hyperplasia MEN1>2A, MEON CDC73 carcinoma, sporadic), FHH (AD CaSR loss, low urine Ca), lithium inhibits CaSR, tertiary in CKD, PTHrP (SCC lung/head-neck). Vit-D 20%: hypervitaminosis; 1α-hydroxylase tumors lymphoma/sarcoidosis/acromegaly. Misc: endocrine (Addison's, pheo, thyrotoxicosis), milk-alkali, thiazide, osteolytic (breast m/c, lung, myeloma).

units.title: Clinical features — acute vs chronic
units.guide: M/c asymptomatic. Acute: abdominal pain/vomiting/constipation (mimics pancreatitis), neuropsychiatric drowsiness/lethargy/confusion/disorientation, short QT. Chronic: fatigue (2nd m/c), painful bones, recurrent stones/UTI, myopathy, band keratopathy, pseudoclubbing. Mnemonic Bone/Stone/Groan/Moans/Overtone. Renal: neurogenic DI → polyuria → dehydration → pre-renal AKI; CTD. No diarrhea/seizures; hypocalcemia = long QT.

units.title: Laboratory investigation algorithm
units.guide: iPTH 2nd gen immunoradiometric, normal 50–100 pg/ml. High Ca with 'normal' PTH → suspect parathyroid dependent. >50 + ↓PO4 + ↑↑urine Ca → adenoma (inferior m/c), Tc99 sestamibi IOC (binds oxyphil). <50 → independent: 25↑&1,25↑ = hypervitaminosis D; 25 N & 1,25↑ = ↑1α-hydroxylase tumors (lymphoma, acromegaly, sarcoidosis); <20 = PTHrP paraneoplastic (SCC lung m/c) → CT/PET. CTD adds hypokalemia, hyperoxaluria, hyperuricosuria.

units.title: 1°/2°/3° hyperparathyroidism and bone changes
units.guide: 1°: adenoma m/c/hyperplasia MEN1-2A, PTH >50, Ca↑ PO4↓. 2°: CKD, PTH 500–1000, Ca↓ PO4↑. 3°: long-standing CKD, PTH >1000, Ca↑↑ PO4↑↑. Bones: 1 diffuse resorption (m/c) — subperiosteal radial side proximal/middle phalanx index+middle finger (most characteristic); 2 rugger jersey (intercortical); 3 brown tumor; 4 salt-pepper skull; 5 endosteal scalloping; 6 acral osteolysis; 7 osteitis fibrosa cystica (resorption > formation → fracture → fibrous/cystic).

units.title: Adenoma surgery indications and hypercalcemic crisis
units.guide: Adenoma: surgery absolute, single-gland excision curative, no medical role. Asymptomatic indications: <50 yr, renal failure, urine Ca >400 mg/day, osteoporosis, S.Ca >1 mg/dl above baseline. Crisis 1st line: fluids 300–400 ml/hr + IV Lasix (not recommended) + calcitonin 4 U/kg S/C BD + IV bisphosphonate (zoledronate 4 mg in 50 ml saline + 50 ml dextrose 5% preferred; pamidronate). 2nd line: oral prednisolone (only osteolysis/Vit-D dependent) + denosumab.

units.title: Malignancy-associated and paediatric hypercalcemia
units.guide: Malignancy: PTHrP m/c (humoral, a/w SCC lung); lymphoma 1α-hydroxylase; osteolysis → crisis (breast m/c, myeloma, lung). Paediatric: Jansen (X-linked, activation mutation PTH type 1 receptor; short stature, dementia, disorientation, abnormal facies, severe bone) vs FHH (AD, CaSR loss; mild, fatigue, weakness).
